info.title: Secure Cloud Platform dashboard API (internal to the dashboard)
info.description:
For the dashboard frontend only; it may change with it. Apps use the public API with API keys.

- **Sessions:** sign up or log in; the session is an HttpOnly cookie, sent by the browser
  (`credentials: "include"`). API keys don't work here.
- **CSRF:** every POST, PUT and DELETE needs the dashboard's `Origin` and, once signed in,
  the token from `GET /dashboard/v1/auth/csrf` in `X-CSRF-Token`.
- **Roles:** owners manage API keys, secrets, connections and file deletion; members can view
  metadata and audit events, and upload and download files.
- **Errors:** `{ "error": { "code", "message", "requestId" } }`, as in the public API.

delete.summary: Delete the workspace for good (owners only)
delete.description:
Crypto-shreds the workspace: its API keys stop working, its key in the secrets service is destroyed (so every secret and every file key of the workspace can never be decrypted again, even from a copy), then its files, connections and memberships are removed. Not undoable.

Confirm by sending the workspace's exact name. If a step fails part-way, the workspace stays "being deleted" (other routes answer 409) and sending this request again finishes it.
